create_DomsevFrameDataset: create a DomsevFrameDataset to load and sample individual image frames with labels from the DoMSEV egocentric video dataset
create_DomsevVideoDataset: create a DomsevVideoDataset to load and sample video clips with frame-level labels from the DoMSEV egocentric video dataset
use_LabelData: use the LabelData dataclass to represent contiguous labels for video segments with video_id, start/stop times, frame indices, and label information
use_LabelType: use the LabelType enum to classify DoMSEV labels into Environment, Activity, or UserAttention categories
use_LABEL_TYPE_2_MAP: use the LABEL_TYPE_2_MAP dictionary to map LabelType enums to their corresponding label ID-to-name mappings for environment, activity, and attention
